## Outreach - Send Drafts Now
Run manually after reviewing the drafts. Sends **every Gmail draft whose subject contains `sendNowSubjectContains`** ("Serving Notice Period") **plus every draft the daily run logged in Mail Log**, starting now, one every **sendNowGapMin (2)** minutes.

- Gmail search picks the drafts; each subject is checked again right before sending
- If a sent draft was made by the daily run, its Mail Log row and the follow-up clock are updated
- Telegram summary at the end
